subject: mathematics
concept: Identifying and naming 2D shapes by their properties (sides and corners)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student traces and counts sides/corners on physical (on-screen) shape tiles
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts pictured shapes into groups by number of sides
exercise.abstract: Student names a shape from a written description of its properties

misconception_flags: confuses similar-sided shapes (e.g. pentagon vs hexagon)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
